{{Top|leg}}
'''Ranch-ark''' was the name given to a series of [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]]-going [[Boat/Legends|boats]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chad/Legends|Chad]]. They were operated by the [[Farmer/Legends|ranching]] families that herded the native [[proop]] and [[bildog]].
